notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Note #1 – Demo Update 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Since the demo launched during Steam Next Fest, we’ve made a few updates — and we’ve just pushed out another one right now! This is our first official patch note, and it covers all the changes from the last small update.

Thanks to everyone who has tried the demo and shared feedback — it’s been super helpful. Here’s what’s new:
[hr][/hr]
🔧 Bug Fixes

Fixed a visual bug when entering a vehicle while the storage UI was open.

Fixed a bug where players could press phone buttons without holding the phone.

Resolved some collider issues on the map.

Fixed phone camera rendering issues on Low graphics settings.

Fixed misaligned POS device buttons.

Pop-up screens can no longer be dragged unintentionally.

Various minor bugs were cleaned up.


💪 Gameplay & Systems

The stamina system has been improved — a new fatigue mechanic has been added to make stamina usage more meaningful.

Object throwing has been temporarily disabled.
Accidental drops were leading to failed missions. We're working on a more reliable system for item handling and delivery damage, and we’ll reintroduce throwing once it's ready.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks again for all the support — keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for more updates! 💚

– The Delivery Guy Team 🚴‍♂️📦
